review.imagery: 37 gallery entries include 10 dated site photographs. All twenty primary assets, the complete 40-page brochure index, 37 native resources and ten September 2026 site photographs were visually reviewed. Two exact primary repeats, textures, generic lifestyle imagery and repeated scene crops were excluded. Nine brochure scenes add project-branded lobby, kitchen, wardrobe and facade. Cross-release SHA-256 evidence identifies shared Sunset Bay 2/3/4 architecture and interiors. Every selected file is independently published in this project’s own source and shared renders retain concept scope. Historical photographs retain their own project history attribution.
review.floorPlans: All eight whole physical pages 2–9 were visually reviewed on two contacts. Ground/podium 1 retain the paired 3 BR duplex townhouse portions. The even-floor group explicitly includes floor 8. The last two sheets distinguish rooftop amenities and technical roof context. The inspected Silver Oak project page exposes no open floor-plan section. No individual home area was inferred. Eight complete building drawings retain the paired townhouse portions, grouped residential levels, rooftop amenities and technical roof context. No individual saleable areas are printed. Confirm complete contractual home sheets, combined townhouse areas and final revisions with Imtiaz.
review.location: Whole original brochure map 9 was rendered at 3200 pixels and visually read. All twelve selected estimates follow its printed schedule. The unnamed metro, source-era La Mer wording, approximate access and proposed island context remain qualified. The official named-place embed has no explicit target coordinates.
review.provenance: Official project/gallery and historical September 2026 construction pages retain dated URL and SHA-256 receipts. Original branded brochures and plan packets retain actual Mitchell’s, REMapp or Reelly host attribution. Whole sheets, notices and source bytes remain intact. Protected researched records remain preserved.
